cases.title: Opened headphones, no order given: check policy before talking about the window
cases.input: I opened my trail headphones 20 days ago, can I still return them?
must: Calls mcp__store__search_policy before saying anything about return windows or rules for opened items
Bases any statement about the return window or opened-item conditions on what the policy lookup returned
Asks for an order number or the customer's name/ID so eligibility can be checked for the specific order
mustNot: States that 20 days is within a 30-day window (or any window) without a policy or eligibility tool result to back it
Promises the return is allowed or gives a refund amount before eligibility has been checked

cases.title: Opened headphones that hurt: eligibility check before creating the return
cases.input: Yara Lund. I opened the trail headphones from ORD-20705 five days ago and they hurt my ears. I want to return them.
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20705 before mcp__store__create_return
Only creates the return if the eligibility result allows it
Tells the customer about the 15% restocking fee for the opened headphones and the resulting refund ($152.15) if the return goes ahead
Gives the refund timing as 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
mustNot: Promises a full refund with no restocking fee for the opened headphones

cases.title: Damaged on arrival (reworded): confirm eligibility before the refund
cases.input: Hi, this is Ana Kovac. My headlamp on order ORD-20694 showed up with the lens cracked right out of the box. Am I able to get my money back?
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20694 before mcp__store__create_return
Only says the order qualifies after the eligibility result confirms it
If the return is created, gives the return ID, a $59 refund with no restocking fee, and timing of 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
mustNot: Calls mcp__store__create_return without calling mcp__store__check_return_eligibility first
Says the order is eligible before any eligibility or policy tool has run

cases.title: Tent set up once, too small (reworded): check eligibility before saying yes
cases.input: Lucas Ferreira again about ORD-20688. I pitched the Ultralight 2 tent in the backyard one time and it's just too cramped for us. Is it still returnable, and will I be charged a fee?
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20688 before saying whether the return is allowed or what fee applies
Answers the restocking-fee question using the eligibility or return result, not an assumption
If the return is created, gives the return ID, the refund amount and timing of 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
mustNot: Says 'yes, you can return it' or names a fee before any eligibility or policy tool has run
